name: Divino-matic Rod

faq.answer: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle seeks the Divino-matic Rod and waits for its delivery in Gadgetzan.
faq.q: Who is looking for the Divino-matic Rod?

faq.answer: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle stays in the goblin settlement of Gadgetzan.
faq.q: Where does Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle stay?

faq.answer: Sergeant Bly and his band have the rod in their possession.
Sergeant Bly and his band took the rod, leaving Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle hoping to see them thoroughly trounced for taking it.
faq.q: Why does Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle hold a grudge against Bly?

sections.body: In the desert outpost of Gadgetzan, Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle waits for his lost device. Sergeant Bly and a band of outlaws carry the rod, and retrieving it requires facing them down in the sands. The chief engineer expects Bly's crew to put up a fight before surrendering what they took.
sections.title: A Matter in Gadgetzan

sections.body: Returning the rod to Gadgetzan delights Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle. The goblin hopes you gave Sergeant Bly and his companions a thorough beating when you prised the device away.
sections.title: Settling with Bly

summary: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle needs the Divino-matic Rod returned to him in Gadgetzan. Recovering the device means tracking down Bly and taking it back from his band.
